findings.telemetry: intent-pollution 24.6% — irrelevant per-session context is the same waste class.
findings.observe_how: Per `.claude/rules/project-registry.md`, NorthStar/Fourth/ECG are SEPARATE project dirs under `C:/Users/david.hayes/Projects/*`, not inside continuous-claude. Yet `northstar-local-dev.md` is in continuous-claude's `.claude/rules/` and `git-sync-workflow.md` forward-syncs all repo rules into active `~/.claude/`, so a NorthStar-only URL note is injected into every continuous-claude (and every other project's) session — confirmed: it is in THIS session's loaded rules. Lowest severity because global-rule injection is partly by design, but a single-project URL belongs in that project's own `.claude/`, not the global set. Payoff: trimming 2-3 project-scoped rules removes recurring off-topic context from unrelated sessions.
